employee parking lot The lion was nowhere in sight

Others were already dashing for their vehicles.
Some darted between cars, clutching their briefcases
hoping to spot the lion before it spotted them. It could

Arnold didn’t know. He did know the doors of

He glanced at his watch. In moments when the
